node.title: XR profile minor-certificate payload
node.statement: For every budget-meeting unpaid non-boundary light-triangle profile, supply either an admissible triangular maximal-minor certificate, an admissible monomial/noncancellation certificate, or a complete remote certificate-table record giving a nonzero maximal-minor specialization. This is reduced to the proved record-inventory soundness rule plus the remaining actual XR profile record inventory payload.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the record-inventory soundness rule and the actual uniform profile-by-profile certificate inventory without local E32 search
node.falsifier: a budget-meeting unpaid non-boundary light profile with no payload entry or with only a determinant-zero or inadmissible specialization
